annotation_policy: Observed package body, observed silkscreen refdes and readable family only. CAD/BOM Rev C candidates do not prove installed identity. Photo-local IDs preserve unresolved identities. Header socket holes remain part of the housing, bare PCB holes/pads are not component instances.
remaining_review: Resolve all remaining tiny resistor/capacitor bodies and crowded arrays using closer views
Verify ambiguous upper IC reference designator and family from macro photos
Complete every supported class instance before training export
Review underside and independent capture sessions; no generated back-side instances
